diagnosis: The Cloudflare Worker retrieves chat room history by routing requests directly to the Durable Object stub identified by roomId without checking whether the authenticated user is a participant of that room. Any authenticated user can read private message history from confidential executive, HR, or legal discussion rooms.
exploit_request:
GET /api/chat-rooms/room_executive_mna_discussion/history HTTP/1.1
Host: chat.edge-mesh.com
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1Ni...
